crossRefs.note: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You…
Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be…
All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

translations.web: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
translations.bsb: He used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, all the utensils for the altar,
translations.kjv: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
translations.asv: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tent of meeting, and the brazen altar, and the brazen grating for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
